title: Restricted weight budget bound
statement: Let $n,a,d,s$ be positive integers with $2a\le d$ and $s\ge1$, and put $\varepsilon=a/d$. Define $M=\left\lceil n\,4d s/a\right\rceil+\left\lceil n\,4d s^2/a\right\rceil$ and $R=(n+1)(s+1)/\varepsilon$. Then $2^{20}(M+1)^8\le 2^{148}R^{88}$.
